visualCharacteristics.purpose: small category/status chips or a short labelled callout

contentPattern.structure: each cell is one item: a short text or link becomes a chip; a cell with a heading or several paragraphs becomes a callout panel

usage.when: status labels (Not covered), topic tags, tier labels and small callouts

reuseGuidance: not-covered for status chips, cyan for dark tier labels, grey for bordered table-like cells, alt for topic link tags.
